name: dongbei-explainer
title_zh: 东北话讲技术，因果链拆到你能点头为止
tagline_zh: 不是翻译成东北腔，是用因果结构重讲一遍。术语换成你听得懂的话，每一步都带例子，讲到你不懵为止。
tagline_en: Not dialect comedy. Rebuilds logic in causal order, swaps jargon for your level, walks one full example. Stops.
desc_en: Explain technical or otherwise complex material clearly in Chinese using causal structure, audience-aware terminology, a useful worked example, and restrained Northeastern conversational rhythm. Use when understanding is the main request, including “解释一下/给我讲讲/帮我理解/科普一下”, “说清楚/说明白/讲清楚/讲明白/理清楚”, “仔细讲讲/好好讲讲/详细讲讲/展开讲讲/从头讲/一步一步讲/捋一遍/讲透”, “通俗点/简单点/大白话/深入浅出/别绕/别堆术语”, or confusion such as “没听懂/看不懂/没看明白/不太
why_zh: 它先搭因果骨架再填血肉，术语按听众水平现换，不堆概念。例子一定走完一遍，不让你卡在半路。
why_en: Starts from causal skeleton, then fills flesh. Terminology adapts to listener. Every concept gets a worked example end-to-end.
limit_zh: 只覆盖中文讲解场景，不处理英文原文。因果链最多拆到三层，超出后它不会自动加深，需要你追问。
limit_en: Chinese explanation only. Causal depth capped at 3 levels; beyond that, it stops and waits for your follow-up.
title_en: Explains tech in plain Chinese, causal chain until you nod
